title: ChairCapitalParams
description: SPEC-COMM-7: Chair capital persuasion parameters. The per-meeting budget is computed from the Chair's credibility standing and refreshed each meeting (no banking). Spending capital on a member widens their compromise band for that meeting only.

base_capital.description: Minimum persuasion budget even at zero credibility (integer units).

credibility_weight.description: Additional budget units per credibility point (floored): budget += floor(credibility_weight * credibility).

band_widen_per_unit.description: How much (in rate units) each spent capital unit widens a member's compromise band for the current meeting.

max_spend_per_member.description: Maximum capital units spendable on a single member per meeting (caps over-concentration).
